description: Research a question in one call, server-side: runs up to 5 web searches (sub-queries) concurrently, dedupes the pages by URL, ranks them all against the question with a cross-encoder and returns one Markdown evidence pack with numbered [n] sources and their query-pruned passages, quoted verbatim (no generated text). Costs 1 credit per sub-query. Pass your own `sub_queries` (distinct angles on the question) for better coverage. If omitted they are derived from `query`: the query itself, query + "documentation", and query + "benchmark" when it asks about speed, performance or comparisons, else query + "example" (a suffix the query already contains is skipped).

sub_queries.description: Up to 5 search queries covering different angles of the question. Recommended.

name: contextfetch_research
title: ContextFetch research (evidence pack)
